entities.name: François 'Papa Doc' Duvalier
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Leader of Haiti (1957–1971). Country doctor turned dictator; President for Life 1964; Tonton Macoutes paramilitary; Vodou imagery for control; estimated 30,000-60,000 killed; anti-mulatto; Cold War US tolerance; died in office
